name: 特殊学生支持 · 新转学生
description_zh: 为教师生成针对新转学生的多维支持方案：课堂支持 + 作业调整 + 家校沟通 + IEP 个别化辅导计划；严守不诊断、不暴露隐私的红线。触发关键词：新转学生、转学、跨地区、跨学制、跨语言、入学适应、特殊需要学生支持、个别化辅导计划、IEP。
description_en: Generates multi-dimensional support plans for teachers targeting new transfer students: classroom support + homework adjustments + home-school communication + IEP individualized support plan; strictly upholds red lines of not diagnosing and not disclosing privacy. Trigger keywords: new transfer student, transfer, cross-region, cross-system, cross-language, school-entry adaptation, special-needs student support, individualized education plan, IEP.
